summary: Both new features fully verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest passing including deterministic lesion generation for sample_dr_02, empty lesions for sample_normal_01, and microaneurysm-only lesions for sample_dr_mild_03; /api/screenings records include the lesions field. Frontend: end-to-end flow works via public Expo preview (previous blank-screen issue is resolved). Lesion heatmap card renders subtitle '5 suspicious regions localized' with legend counts 3+1+1=5 for dr_02, and 'No suspicious regions localized' + 'FUNDUS CLEAR · NO LESIONS MAPPED' badge for normal_01. HEATMAP toggle switches between HEATMAP ON/OFF correctly. Download PDF button transitions idle -> '✓ PDF REPORT READY' and successfully triggers window.print on web with no JS errors. Share/copy button shows '✓ SUMMARY COPIED TO CLIPBOARD'. scan-another returns to exactly one upload-screen (no stale results). History modal opens and past scans re-render results. No uncaught console errors — only two React-Native-Web deprecation warnings.

issues: The three curated Unsplash sample images (sample_normal_01, sample_dr_02, sample_dr_mild_03) are NOT actual retinal fundus photographs — they show a person at a slit-lamp, ophthalmic equipment, and similar stock photos. The lesion overlay ends up on unrelated content (face, machinery), which is visually misleading for a clinical prototype. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:122,145,168.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Affects components using shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LesionHeatmapOverlay.tsx:77-83,313-317 and /app/frontend/app/results.tsx:322-325.
React-Native-Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LesionHeatmapOverlay.tsx:67-68,135.

action_items: Replace the three sample Unsplash URLs in SAMPLE_FUNDUS_DATA with actual retinal fundus images (or bundled local assets) so lesion overlays land on medically-relevant content. This is a demo-credibility issue.
Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow on web (or wrap in Platform.select) in LesionHeatmapOverlay.tsx and results.tsx primaryCta to silence React-Native-Web warnings.
Move pointerEvents from props to style.pointerEvents in LesionHeatmapOverlay.tsx (lines 67, 68, 135).
Consider adding testID='scan-history-modal' explicitly documented in the request path (currently the modal renders and can be located via existing testIDs).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate_lesion_map is deterministic via random.Random(seed) — verified by two identical /api/predict calls returning identical lesion arrays.
PredictRequest input validation correctly returns 400 when no image/sample provided.
ScreeningRecord.lesions defaults to [] and is persisted to Mongo — verified via GET /api/screenings.
ReportExportCard has a robust clipboard fallback (execCommand for sandboxed browsers) and PDF handler correctly branches on Platform.OS === 'web'.
MongoDB _id is properly serialized via PyObjectId BeforeValidator; no ObjectId leakage in responses.
seed_data_creation: New screening records inserted through live /api/predict calls for sample_dr_02, sample_normal_01, sample_dr_mild_03 during pytest and Playwright runs. No manual seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New lesion heatmap + PDF export features are fully functional. Only outstanding items are (1) non-fundus sample images and (2) two RN-Web deprecation warnings — both non-blocking. Public preview mounts correctly again; earlier iteration 3 blank-screen issue is resolved.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the two new features.
